title: Extensive log messages withgrouped_gemmcompile
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Recently seeing a lot of extensive logs when compiling `torch.grouped_mm`. This is with default `torch.compile` settings and cuda graphs disabled, will probably be reproducible with other as well. Error pasted below. cc @drisspg as discussed and @jananisriram 

### Error logs
Shared memory logs are expected, but the `UserWarnings` aren't. These can grow very large, up to 5-15k lines per compile run.

```

```
